items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: Kiku, a fellow like Kiku and like myself, we call ourselves young musicians outside of these people I'm talking about.

ctx.x: The real old musicians were all gone. Much like most of them are gone. All gone. Kiku is about one of the old. And then Kiku.
Kiku, a fellow like Kiku and like myself, we call ourselves young musicians outside of these people I'm talking about. Because when I was a kid, just coming up with boys, those people were men.
Oh, yeah. They were old enough.
